SWZ.note: Only says cybersecurity awareness should target all employee classes; no civil-service digital-skills programme stated.

facts.fact: A Ministry of ICT engineer says the Ministry established the National Cybersecurity Agency at ESCCOM to coordinate all cybersecurity issues, with the National Computer Incident Response Team (NCIRT) established under it.
A Ministry of ICT engineer says Government developed the National Cybersecurity Strategy 2022-2027.
A Ministry of ICT engineer says Government has enacted the Computer Crime and Cybercrime Act, 2022.

SWZ.note: Data Protection Act 2022 is named only among frameworks the speaker helped develop; enactment or commencement not stated.
Electronic Communications and Transactions Act, 2022 is named only among frameworks the speaker helped develop; enactment or commencement not stated.
Police Service only named as a platform for reporting incidents; no station records stated.
No consultation of people outside government stated.
